entry.name: mc.dup~
entry.digest: Create a multichannel signal that duplicates a single-channel input
entry.description: The mc.dup~ object creates multichannel signals from a single-channel signals by duplicating the input across all channels of the output.

arguments.name: channel count
arguments.description: Specify the number of channels in the duplicated multichannel output (default 2).
